title: Hyaluronidase for Sclerodactyly in Systemic Sclerosis Trial
official: Digital Intradermal Hyaluronidase for Sclerodactyly in Systemic Sclerosis
summary: Translational studies have demonstrated reduced hyaluronidase activity in the skin of patients with systemic sclerosis. It is thought this may contribute to the progressive fibrosis seen in this disease. Several studies have demonstrated that exogenous hyaluronidase is very effective at improving systemic sclerosis associated microstomia. Therefore, this study aims to explore hyaluronidase for systemic sclerosis associated sclerodactyly.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18 and \<60 years
* Diagnosis of systemic sclerosis
* Presence of sclerodactyly
* Ability to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known hypersensitivity to hyaluronidase
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding
* Unstable systemic disease
* Recent changes in systemic immunomodulatory therapy
* Conditions interfering with safe digital injections
